title: Post-earnings-announcement drift from SEC 8-K Item 2.02 filings, 2005-2026
run_policy: single run; no threshold tuning; every extra variant logged to things_tried.csv

events.source: research/earn/sec_sub_raw_0..4.jsonl (SEC submissions API, 8-K filings carrying Item 2.02)
events.form_filter: form == '8-K' only (8-K/A excluded: amendments/corrections, not the announcement)
events.ticker_mapping: first CIK ticker (SEC order) that has a daily-bar file; symbol->yf mapping via us_common_symbols.csv
events.dedupe: per ticker, drop a filing whose reaction day is within 5 sessions after a kept filing
events.acceptance_to_ET: UTC acceptance -> ET with US DST rules (2007+: 2nd Sun Mar .. 1st Sun Nov; 2004-06: 1st Sun Apr .. last Sun Oct)

reaction_day_R.pre: ET time < 09:30 -> R = that session (next session if not a trading day)
reaction_day_R.intra: 09:30 <= ET time < 16:00 on a trading day -> R = same session, flagged 'intra'

events.calendar: SPY daily file is the master trading calendar; all bars reindexed to it (7-session hole 2024-09-03..11 becomes NaN and drops any trade whose entry/exit needs it)

universe_filters_through_R_minus_1.adv20_definition: mean(close*volume) over the 20 sessions ending R-1 (min 15 observations)

signal_at_close_of_R.reaction: close_R/close_{R-1} - 1 minus SPY close-to-close same day
signal_at_close_of_R.volume_ratio: volume_R / mean share volume over the 20 sessions ending R-1

trade.entry_sensitivity: Close_R (reported, not in the Holm family)
trade.exit: Close_{R+h}, h in {1,5,20,60} sessions after R
trade.net_excess: (exit/entry - 1) - (SPY exit/SPY entry - 1 over the identical bars) - round-trip cost

benchmarks.spy: SPY over the identical entry/exit bars

matched_controls.pool: names eligible on R (same filters through R-1) that are not the event name
matched_controls.same_adv_decile: decile of ADV20$ among eligible names on R (rank-based, floor(rank*10/n))
matched_controls.no_8k: no Item 2.02 8-K reaction day within +-5 sessions of R
matched_controls.sample: up to 5 controls per event, numpy default_rng(20260913), fixed draw order (events sorted by R then ticker)
matched_controls.statistic: event net excess minus mean control net excess (controls charged their own tier costs); events with zero controls excluded from the control statistic and their share reported

cells_holm_family_of_8.C1_h5: top quintile of reaction among eligible events in the same calendar month (>=10 events in month); long; h=5
cells_holm_family_of_8.C2_h5: big-beat proxy: reaction >= +0.08 AND volume_ratio >= 3.0; long; h=5
cells_holm_family_of_8.C3_h5: bottom quintile of reaction within calendar month; evaluated as SHORT (stat = -long net excess, same costs, no borrow fee); h=5
cells_holm_family_of_8.C4_h20: top quintile AND 50M <= ADV20$ < 500M; long; h=20
cells_holm_family_of_8.C5_h20: top quintile AND ADV20$ in the top tercile of eligible events in the same calendar month; long; h=20

descriptive_only_not_in_family: h=1 and h=60 for every cell
C1 with a trailing-250-event 80th-percentile threshold (look-ahead-free variant of the month quintile)

windows.discovery: R in 2005-01-01..2014-12-31 (bars1d_2004_2013 + 2014 part of bars1d_10y; 1,225-name survivor universe before 2014)

inference.ci: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap, 2,000 reps, clusters = R date and calendar quarter of R; the wider interval is reported
inference.p: one-sided bootstrap p (share of resampled means on the wrong side of zero), max over the two cluster levels, floored at 1/(2*reps)
inference.holm: Holm step-down over the 8 family cells, TEST window only

pass_criteria_TEST_all_required.years_positive_definition: calendar years of R in TEST with >= 10 trades in the cell

also_report: per-capital K=10 equal-weight (1/K fixed weights, max 10 concurrent, first-come by entry date then reaction desc) with max drawdown, C1_h20 and C2_h20
share of C1 explained by matched controls (news or move?)
known_caveats: survivorship: symbol list as of 2026-09, delisted names absent (favours long continuation, hurts C3 short)
month-quintile threshold uses events later in the same month (mild look-ahead; trailing variant reported)
8-K 2.02 coverage in 2004-2013 is partial (many filers used other channels early on)
control matching within +-1 pp of day-0 excess may leave extreme reactions (C2) with few controls
